name: Gallifa (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the red cockerel of the arms.
history: The flag was approved on 8 September 2006 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4727 of 27 September 2006; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with the red cockerel of the arms 4/6 of the height at the centre.

features.role: cockerel of the arms, 4/6 of the height
